review.question: How should the times on the paused line read in dark mode?
review.recommendation_reason: It meets the contrast rule in both appearances with one colour change.
review.title: How should the times on the paused line read in dark mode?
review.why:
QA found the times on the paused line too faint in dark mode at laptop size: 2.9 to 1 against the page.

The design system asks for 4.5 to 1. Two of the fixes below meet it; they differ in how busy the line looks.
